description: Create a payment for a positive integer cents amount.

amount.description: The payment amount in integer cents (must be positive).

currency.description: Currency code for the payment (default USD).

source_id.description: Payment source id / card nonce (default cnon:card-nonce-ok).

customer_id.description: Optional customer id to attach the payment to.

order_id.description: Optional order id to attach the payment to.

location_id.description: Location id for the payment (default LOC_MAIN).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the created payment; on failure (invalid amount or customer not found), output contains an error message.

description: Refund all or part of an existing payment.

payment_id.description: The id of the payment to refund.

amount.description: Optional refund amount in integer cents; defaults to the full payment amount.

currency.description: Currency code for the refund (default USD).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the created refund; on failure (payment not found or amount exceeds payment), output contains an error message.
